afterAnswerTip.message: Enter sends the message when pi has answered

whilePiWorksNote.message: What Enter does with a message while pi works. Alt+Enter sends it the other way.

sendDefaultPrompt.message: Send it with the default prompt

selectionNote.message: Ask pi uses the prompt starred under Prompts. "Add to message" always puts only the selected text in the message box.

promptsNote.message: The pi menu's items, in this order. The star marks the one Ask pi uses. A prompt switched off stays here, out of the menu and the / list.

resetWarning.message: Your changes and the prompts you added are deleted.

toolsScope.message: For every chat and every site.

readPageNote.message: Reads the text of the page.

observePageNote.message: Lists the links, buttons, fields, and headings on the page.

actPageNote.message: Clicks, types, scrolls, and goes to pages of the same site; follows links to other sites you allow.

actAskNote.message: : pi asks once per answer for each site.

actOnNote.message: : pi may click and type without asking, also on buttons such as Submit or Delete.

runScriptNote.message: Runs JavaScript that pi writes, on the page.

scriptWarning.message: A script runs as you on the site, with your login: it could read and change anything you can there, and send what it reads to other sites. Ask: pi shows each script first; "For this answer" or "For this chat" lets the next ones on that site run without asking until the answer, or the chat, ends (a new chat, Chrome closing, or a change here). On: scripts run without asking. Stop does not end a script that is already running.

needsUserScripts.message: Needs Chrome's "Allow User Scripts" for pi

screenshotPageNote.message: Captures what the tab shows, as an image.

screenshotWarning.message: The image shows what is on screen, also what you typed into fields, and goes to the model's provider. pi may scroll the page first, also with Act on page Off. Works after you open pi on the site with its toolbar button, menu, or shortcut, or on any site when Chrome allows pi on all sites (Settings > Advanced > Sites).

callsNote.message: 5 to 200, for all page tools together.

sitesNote.message: pi uses these sites without asking, also when a link takes the tab there. On other sites, only the page you open pi on; when pi needs another site, it asks you first.

sitesProvidersNote.message: pi also reads these without a click: it has access to them for your providers. Chrome's details page for pi lists them under Site access.

diagnosticsNote.message: The extension's status, test probes, and log, for reporting a problem.

manifestDescription.message: An AI agent in the side panel: ask about a page, or let it click, type, and gather data for you. Unofficial; built on pi-durable.

commandAsk.message: Ask pi about the selection (default prompt)

commandAdd.message: Add the selection to the message box (no prompt)
